_about: Fixes to Greek in Stephens's notes. Checked on 9 Nov 2026 against page images of the 1889 printing (Archive.org scan selectlibraryofn09auguuoft). 'ccel' = the online transcription garbled what 1889 printed correctly; 'misprint' = the 1889 printing itself was wrong and the fix corrects it.
fixes: Book I note on the episcopate (1889 p. 35): breathing lost in transcription
Book IV, Matt. xxiv. 51 note (p. 61): a letter dropped in transcription
Εἰ δ’ οὕτω σὺ ποιεῖς μοι ἀπόκτεινόν με
Book IV, Numb. xi. 15 LXX note (p. 61)
Book IV note on commerce (p. 63): breathing set as an apostrophe
Book IV note on the Stoics (p. 65)
Book IV note on rhetorical artifice (p. 67)
Book VI, other reading (p. 79): 1889 printed 'λσιπὰς βχάβας', a printer's error for 'the remaining injuries'
1889 p. 64, note 8, prints 'seio'; the Latin is 'Haud scio an' (I hardly know whether). Checked against the scan, leaf 76.

editor_notes.τὰς λοιπὰς βλάβας: [Ed.: the 1889 printing reads τὰς λσιπὰς βχάβας, a misprint.]
editor_notes.Haud scio: [Ed.: the 1889 printing reads seio, a misprint.]
